meta_description:
8,636 likes, 123 comments - tanyakhanijow on September 19, 2026: "Most insane off-roading experience in Sikkim!

This might just be one of the bumpiest roads I’ve ever taken.
There were stretches where I genuinely wondered if we were still going the right way. And imagine, this is how the locals travel every time they need access to hospitals, doctors, services. Even construction material for homes is transported through these 😳

And after all of that, we finally reached this incredibly remote corner of Sikkim and suddenly, the entire journey felt worth it.

Want to see where this road took me? Check out my latest YouTube video.".
